items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: This Romero girl had studied with her.

ctx.x: Monetta had many white pupils, my teacher. Oh yes. All through the years. Oh yes.

Well over in life, he had over there for instance this very fine piano teacher that passed away some years ago, and she has a number of white students. This Romero girl had studied with her. Yeah, that makes sense.
But anyhow, when you came to New Orleans, did you hear any bands before you started playing? Oh yeah. Did you go out and listen? Well sure. Who would you go and listen to before you?
